toegepas.voor: naby die ewenaar waar die land
toegepas.na: naby die ewenaar, waar die land
toegepas.rede_vinder: The 'waar' clause adds information about the equator rather than singling out part of it, so it takes a comma.
toegepas.fout: A non-restrictive 'waar' clause describing the place near the equator has no comma before it.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The clause adds information rather than narrowing the equator, so the AWS comma is right and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS writes an ordinal joined to a superlative as one word: 'tweedehoogste'.
toegepas.fout: 'tweede hoogste' is written apart; the AWS joins an ordinal to a superlative.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'tweedehoogste' is a plain spelling fix that leaves 'Berg Kenia' and the claim untouched.

na_skrywer.voor: Groot lopende water wat in 'n vaste baan oor die land vloei.
na_skrywer.na: 'n Groot stroom water wat in 'n vaste baan oor die land vloei.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Groot lopende water' with no article or countable noun reads as a fragment; 'n Groot stroom water' is the natural form of the same definition.
na_skrywer.fout: The glossary definition opens with an articleless fragment, 'Groot lopende water'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The wording may deserve a fix, but this rewords a glossary definition and swaps 'lopende water' for 'stroom', so it must go through the writer for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: 'n Meer is 'n groot hoeveelheid water wat deur land omring word.
vlae.rede: This study sentence defines 'meer' with only the first half of the decided shared wording (it leaves out 'en meestal vanself gevorm het'); not a language fault, so not changed, but a person may want to check it against the shared-definition rule.
